protocol.design: Post-hoc deterministic formatting analysis motivated by malformed responses observed during the primary run. No further model generation, no prompt change, no new clinical terms, and no replacement of strict primary results. Not independent validation.
allowed_changes: Remove an outer Markdown JSON fence only if the entire inside is valid JSON
Remove one trailing double quote only after a complete JSON object, as confirmed by JSONDecoder.raw_decode
forbidden_changes: Do not complete missing braces, strings, fields or truncated items
Do not discard arbitrary prose or extra objects
Do not coerce booleans, infer symptoms, or change evidence quotations
protocol.scoring: Same 200 cached generations and projected reference as primary study; apply identical grounding and canonical-name checks after formatting. Count every adjustment, remaining failure, and all records in denominators.
